+/**
+ * Perform a token refresh with single-flight deduplication.
+ * Multiple concurrent calls will share the same refresh promise.
+ */
+async function performTokenRefresh(): Promise<string> {
+  if (pendingRefresh) {
+    return pendingRefresh;
+  }
+
+  const refreshPromise = refreshAuthToken()
+    .then((newToken) => {
+      return newToken;
+    })
+    .finally(() => {
+      pendingRefresh = null;
+    });
+
+  pendingRefresh = refreshPromise;
+  return refreshPromise;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Check if a request is the token refresh endpoint itself.
+ * We should not retry refresh requests to avoid infinite loops.
+ */
+function isRefreshRequest(url: string): boolean {
+  return url.includes(REFRESH_ENDPOINT_PATH);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Execute a fetch request with the given config, adding auth headers.
+ */
+async function executeRequest<T>(
+  url: string,
+  options: RequestInit,
+  config?: RequestConfig
+): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
+  const headers = new Headers(options.headers || {});
+  
+  // Add auth token if available and not already set
+  const authToken = getAuthToken();
+  if (authToken && !headers.has('Authorization')) {
+    headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${authToken}`);
+  }
+
+  // Add legacy API key if configured
+  const legacyApiKey = (typeof import.meta !== 'undefined' && import.meta.env?.VITE_LEGACY_API_KEY) || '';
+  if (legacyApiKey) {
+    headers.set(LEGACY_API_KEY_HEADER, legacyApiKey);
+  }
+
+  // Add API version header
+  headers.set(API_VERSION_HEADER, '2024-01');
+
+  const fetchOptions: RequestInit = {
+    ...options,
+    headers,
+    signal: config?.signal,
+  };
+
+  const response = await fetch(url, fetchOptions);
+  const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
+
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    const error: ApiError = {
+      code: response.status,
+      message: data.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`,
+      details: data.details,
+      requestId: data.requestId,
+      timestamp: data.timestamp,
+      path: data.path,
+      suggestion: data.suggestion,
+    };
+    throw error;
+  }
+
+  return {
+    data: data as T,
+    status: response.status,
+    message: data.message,
+    requestId: data.requestId,
+    pagination: data.pagination,
+  };
+}
